adapter_tests.command: cd tb-mcp-rs && cargo +1.99.0 test --offline; value is the sum of `passed` across the 46 suites the log recorded

engine_lib_tests.command: cd tb-engine && cargo +1.99.0 test --offline -p tb-engine --lib; value is the sum of `passed` across the 1 suites the log recorded

engine_it_tests.command: cd tb-engine && cargo +1.99.0 test --offline -p tb-engine --test it; value is the sum of `passed` across the 1 suites the log recorded

memory.source: ps -o rss= -p $(systemctl show 2brain-engine -p MainPID --value); find /root/vault -name '*.md' | wc -l; date 2026-11-16

knowledge_base.source: tools/kb/census.py --json (frontmatter) + engine graph_shape; 2026-11-17 after two MOC passes

graph.command: 2brain mcp /root/vault then tb_graph_health {"limit": 200}; or engine_probe.py --verb tb_graph_health on the live socket
graph.source: engine c9df1cbd (release 2 + window advisory), adapter 0.1.0+020d0de, vault HEAD
